_description: Twilio call/SMS audit-log → AKSI control ID mapping. Twilio is the leading communications platform for AI agents (voice agents making outbound calls, SMS agents sending notifications, fraud-detection agents placing verification calls). Voice/SMS communication carries direct PII (phone numbers, conversation content) plus heavy regulatory exposure (TCPA in US, GDPR in EU). The record SID prefix (CA*=call, SM*/MM*=message, AU*=audit) drives auto-dispatch: a single import file may mix call records, message records, and admin audit-log entries. Direction (inbound vs outbound-api), status, error_code, answered_by, num_media, is_marketing, and country-code pairings produce additive flags. Marketing SMS without verified consent is a direct TCPA-violation indicator (FAIL). Twilio error 30007 (US carrier filtering = spam reputation) and 30003 (invalid number = input validation) are surfaced as PR-04 and PR-03 respectively. Velocity (>N records to same destination in 24h) and cross-country fan-out (one account_sid spanning >N country codes) produce synthetic findings. Phone numbers are NEVER stored in raw E.164 form: only the country_code + last-2-digits mask survives (PII reduction). caller_name (CNAM) and message body/text content are dropped entirely.
